messages:
sara: T-minus 30 for EU change window. Quick signalboard check before we flip the traffic and start the soft-freeze.
calvin: All good from infra side — GPU pools warmed, autoscaler health green, load test replay ok.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/2026-03-21. Canary group: 5%. Targets: inference-runtime v3.4.1 -> v3.5.0.
calvin: Note: v3.5.0 requires kv-cache refresh on first warm request, small latency bump expected for first token.
marta: Docs/ReleaseNotes: added section about KV cache warm and suggested warmup curl. Pushed to /releases/2026-03-21.md.
ops-jon: Who's owning rollback threshold? I suggest 3xx error >1% for 5m OR latency P95 > 750ms for 10m.
ian: +1 on those thresholds. Add an embedding quality regression watch if embeddings devs want it.
sara: Agreed on thresholds. Setting alert channels: #eng-oncall and #incidents. Can we pin the runtime while we ramp canary?
deploy-bot: Pin applied: inference-runtime@v3.5.0 for canary pool. Canary rollstarted by sara.
ryan: I added a small smoke prompt set to the monitoring dash — will track hallucination rate + token delta.
marta: Release notes include rollback steps: 1) cut traffic to canary 2) revert pin 3) redeploy runtime v3.4.1 4) invalidate KV cache if needed.
calvin: Small ops note: if rollback happens, warmup script below to rehydrate caches quickly:
```
for p in {1..10}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $WARMUP_TOKEN" https://eu.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup"}'; sleep 1; done
```
sara: Who's doing production release notes announcement to customers? Marketing or product?
marta: I'll draft the release blurb after we hit 50% ramp. Will include known perf bump and mitigation tips.
ops-jon: During soft-freeze (next 45m) no DB migrations or infra config changes unless emergency. Marking exceptions in the signalboard.
ian: Quick lighting check: can we route fallback to cheaper model variant if latency spikes? Ops side, is that automated?
calvin: Smart routing configured: on P95 > 900ms we fallback to cpu-optimized variant in the same region. Manual override available.
sara: OK team—ramp plan: 5% -> 25% after 10m with smoke green -> 50% after 20m -> full at 60m if all checks pass. Abort conditions: ops thresholds or quality regressions flagged by ryan.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 5% -> 25% (timestamp 1722005588). Metrics: errors 0.1%, p95 420ms.
ryan: Smoke prompts passing, halluc rate steady. No notable token inflation.
marta: Release notes ready draft: will post to #marketing in 15m.
sara: Deployed to 25%. Keeping an eye. If anything bad, ping me and we'll rollback.
calvin: Noting: billing meter change for embeddings in this release — ops aware, but finance FYI later.
ops-jon: Tracker: if rollback invoked, I'll own the revert and tag the incident as "rollback-2026-03-21".
ian: If we abort, prefer roll-forward fix only if it's config-only and low-risk; otherwise revert.
sara: Heads-up: quiet-window enforced for 1h post-full-rollover. No schema changes or hotfixes.
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 25% -> 50% (timestamp 1722005615). Metrics: errors 0.12%, p95 460ms, no quality alerts.
ryan: Quality dash still green. Proceeding to 50% -> prepping 50%->100% notes.
marta: Posting release notes to #marketing now.
sara: Go/no-go: GO from me. If anyone sees anything, call rollback immediately. :thumbsup:
